title: The Diagnostic Contract — the envelope
description: C2 of the Softanza reference design: the shape of every diagnostic a conforming court emits in machine form. One object per diagnostic. Prose governing this shape is doc/diagnostic-contract.md; this file is what a court validates against. Version v1.0, 2026-08-08.

code.description: The court's stable diagnostic identifier. Stable forever, never reused, unique within its language. Attested forms: MISSING_UNDO, ZUI-W001.

severity.description: The two-rung ladder, closed: error (unlawful; a build must fail) or warning (lawful but suspect, or undecidable without more input).

message.description: Human prose, in whatever language the operator reads. Never compared, never normative — the code and the cites carry the law.

span.description: Where the finding lands. line 0 means the finding is file-wide. col is reserved: optional, >= 1 when known.

cites.description: Citations into the court's pinned instrument, by stable identifier only. Empty is honest where no law applies (structural and grammar diagnostics).

language.description: The language being judged — and therefore the instrument the cites resolve in. zui today; zql, face, wflow as their courts adopt.
